messages.content:
Risk: Personal information disclosure
Description: Personal information or sensitive personal information that is included as a part of a prompt that is sent to the model.
Concern: If personal information or sensitive personal information is included in the prompt, it might be unintentionally disclosed in the models' output. In addition to accidental disclosure, prompt data might be stored or later used for other purposes like model evaluation and retraining, and might appear in their output if not properly removed. 
Policy: Executive Compensation

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/SecuritiesIssuance/IssuanceProcess/RegistrationInformation: registration information — Information relating to the registration of a registered security. [found by 5/8 queries]
  Siblings: debt issuance process information, issue subscription information, underwriting process details
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoansRegulatory/DataProtectionRequirement: data protection requirement — Requirements defining how data about individuals is held. Example is the EU DA directive and laws, which make the data the property of the individual that data is about. Covers - what information i sheld - who information can be divulged to. - the individual's rights in respect of that information Privacy regulations cover most of this. EU defines "Personal Data" and "Sensitive Personal Data". For credit reference agencies the latter would be covered. More detail about whether they can divulge facts which are not subject to formal judgements etc. [found by 5/8 queries]
  Siblings: notification obligation, delivery obligation, securities restriction
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Notice: notice — announcement, communication, intimation, or advance warning of something, usually, but not necessarily, to allow preparations to be made [found by 6/8 queries]
  Siblings: indication of interest, publication, reference document
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualIdentifiers/ContextualIdentificationScheme: contextual identification scheme — identification scheme that applies within one or more contexts [found by 6/8 queries]
  Siblings: driver's license identification scheme, tax identification scheme, national identification number scheme
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#HealthDataExposure: Health Data Exposure — Unauthorized disclosure of protected health information including medical records, diagnoses, treatments, or prescription histories. [found by 5/8 queries]
  Siblings: Unauthorized Surveillance, Direct Identifier Exposure, Employment Data Exposure
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/ContextualDesignators/Context: context — situation or frame of reference in which something applies, exists, happens, or is used and that helps to illustrate or explain it [from restriction: isApplicableIn on ContextualIdentificationScheme]

axes.rationale: This class is directly relevant as it defines how personal and sensitive personal information should be handled, which is central to the risk of personal information disclosure.
This class is relevant because it specifically addresses the unauthorized disclosure of protected health information, a type of sensitive personal information.
